si.t: Implements a server listening to incoming clients
Builds without errors and runs successfully
Uses pure-HTTP library only (no web-framework like ASP, Spring, JSP,.. allowed)
Uses a Postgres Database for storing data
Does not use an OR-Mapping Library
Implements at least 20 meaningful unit tests
Endpoints use HTTP path, params, headers and content correctly
REST API Endpoints (register, login, ...) defined according to specs
Register and login users, user state management
Create, update, delete media entries (by owner)
Rate media (1–5 stars), add/edit/delete comment, like ratings
Mark and unmark media as favorites
View rating history and favorites list
One rating per user per media (editable)
Comments require confirmation before public visibility
Recommendation system based on rating history & similarity
Search and filter media (title, genre, type, age restriction, rating)
Ownership logic (only creator can modify media)
Data is persisted using PostgreSQL and Docker
Code clearly reflects at least 2 SOLID principles
Integration Tests (Postman Collection or Curl script)
Describes app design (decisions, structure, class diagrams)
Explains unit testing strategy and coverage
Explains at least 2 SOLID principles with real examples
Contains tracked time for major tasks
